Data

Sorted by Deezer popularity score; unranked songs last. Scores are a popularity proxy, not play counts or sales. Updated —.

Published ranges come from Singing Carrots and MyVocalRange. Songs with missing ranges are omitted. Multiple published arrangements are tested separately. Song links search KaraFun’s YouTube channel.

The suggested octave is calculated afresh for your selected notes; whole-octave shifts preserve the width of the melody. Some published arrangements exceed the two-octave presets and need a wider custom range.

Preset ranges are starting points. Singer labels come from source metadata; unclassified entries are Unknown. MyVocalRange male parts are converted down one octave. Where both sources confirm an octave discrepancy in the same key, the range is corrected and documented; other source errors can remain.

Octave-shifted matches must fit completely and, with Keep energetic enabled, peak at most 3 semitones below your upper limit. This peak-based estimate cannot establish chorus energy. Two-octave shifts are uncommon and optional. Each song prefers original pitch, then the smallest fitting octave shift, up or down.

Power and Popular: red → yellow → bright green at maximum. Popularity uses Deezer’s unitless indicator, not play counts. Grey hatched squares mean unavailable. Range and Popular headers toggle ascending/descending; unavailable values stay last.

During search, the most popular matching song excluded by your filters appears separately below the results. The caption identifies the excluding filters; if no allowed octave fits, its published range is shown.

Piano: Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm, CC BY 3.0. Slider handles play notes; presets stay silent.
